title: AI Meeting Assistant — "Meeting Mind"
tagline: Audio → transcript → summary → RAG chat, end-to-end.
description: End-to-end audio intelligence pipeline that ingests YouTube URLs or uploaded files, transcribes with local Whisper (offline + Hindi→English), summarizes via a LangChain LCEL + Mistral chain, and enables conversational Q&A over transcripts through a ChromaDB RAG store — all wrapped in a Streamlit UI with PDF/TXT export.
bullets: Ingestion of YouTube + uploads with yt-dlp / pydub and automatic chunking for long-form content.
Local Whisper ASR (faster-whisper) with Hindi→English translation support.
LangChain LCEL summarization chain (Mistral API) producing summaries, action items and decisions.
RAG pipeline (ChromaDB + HuggingFace embeddings) for follow-up questions over the meeting.

title: AI-Powered Fraud Detection & Identity Verification
tagline: OCR + CNN + Random Forest for identity docs — 94% precision.
description: Multi-stage document verification pipeline that extracts structured identity fields from noisy scans, then classifies authenticity using a CNN (98%) alongside a Random Forest fraud model (94%), with facial-landmark cross-verification for multimodal validation.
bullets: Tesseract + OpenCV OCR pipeline over noisy scanned identity documents.
CNN authenticity classifier reaching 98% accuracy on the validation set.
Random Forest fraud model at 94% precision on identity verification patterns.
Facial landmark cross-verification tying document to selfie for multimodal fraud signal.

title: YouTube RAG Chatbot
tagline: Chat with any YouTube video via local LLaMA 3.1 + FAISS.
description: Full-stack RAG chatbot that turns any YouTube video into a conversational knowledge source — transcript extraction, semantic chunking, FAISS vector indexing, and a locally-hosted LLaMA 3.1 8B inference backend. Multi-user architecture with UUID-scoped conversations and isolated per-video vector stores.
bullets: Automatic transcript extraction + semantic chunking per video.
Per-video FAISS store for isolated, low-latency retrieval.
Local LLaMA 3.1 8B inference via Ollama — no API keys required.
FastAPI backend + SQLite persistence + responsive HTML/CSS/JS frontend.

title: NOVA — Real-Time Gesture-Based HCI
tagline: Hands-free OS control using MediaPipe landmarks.
description: Real-time human-computer interaction system that detects hand and face landmarks with MediaPipe and classifies 5+ gestures (pinch, scroll, eye-blink, head-cursor) at >95% accuracy, exposed as a Django REST dashboard with live video streaming for hands-free OS control.
bullets: MediaPipe + OpenCV landmark detection at real-time framerates.
5+ gesture classes (pinch / scroll / blink / head-cursor) at >95% accuracy.
PyAutoGUI action layer maps gestures to OS-level input.
Django REST dashboard with live MJPEG video streaming.

title: RAG-Based PDF Chatbot
tagline: Ask questions across any uploaded PDF, grounded in the source.
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot that ingests uploaded PDFs, embeds their content, and answers questions with citations drawn from the source. FastAPI backend + Streamlit frontend.
bullets: PDF ingestion + chunking + HuggingFace embeddings.
ChromaDB semantic search with source-grounded answers.
FastAPI backend + Streamlit frontend for a clean upload → chat flow.

title: BERT-Based Sentiment Analysis
tagline: Fine-tuned BERT for multi-class review sentiment.
description: Fine-tuned BERT model for multi-class sentiment classification of customer reviews, with careful evaluation via precision, recall and F1 across classes to surface the true minority-class performance.
bullets: HuggingFace Transformers + PyTorch training loop.
Multi-class sentiment with per-class precision / recall / F1 reporting.
Data pipeline for cleaning, tokenizing and balancing customer review text.

title: Customer Churn Prediction — End-to-End ML Pipeline
tagline: Production-shaped sklearn pipeline with +12% accuracy from tuning.
description: Production-style ML pipeline built with sklearn Pipeline / ColumnTransformer covering imputation, encoding, scaling and feature selection, tuned with GridSearchCV for a +12% accuracy lift, and Pickle-serialized for deployment.
bullets: sklearn Pipeline + ColumnTransformer covering imputation → encoding → scaling → feature selection.
GridSearchCV hyperparameter search delivering +12% accuracy over baseline.
Pickle serialization ready for FastAPI / Flask deployment.
